_about: Target data layer for GA4 ecommerce and lead generation, read by scripts/datalayer_spec.py. Checked against Google's GA4 recommended events reference (developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events) on 16/11/2026. Re-check when Google changes the reference and note the date here.

select_item.where: Click on a product in a list

add_to_cart.where: Add to basket succeeded (not the click)

form_start.where: First field touched (enhanced measurement sends this)

generate_lead.where: Form submitted AND the platform confirmed success

qualify_lead.where: CRM: lead marked qualified (offline / Measurement Protocol)

hubspot.label: HubSpot forms
hubspot.listener: Legacy embed: window message event where event.data.type === 'hsFormCallback' and event.data.eventName === 'onFormSubmitted'. New forms editor: window event 'hs-form-event:on-submission:success'.
hubspot.verify: Check which embed version the site uses in GTM Preview.

marketo.label: Marketo forms
marketo.listener: MktoForms2.whenReady(form => form.onSuccess(() => { dataLayer.push({...}); return true; })) - returning true keeps Marketo's own redirect.

gravity_forms.label: Gravity Forms
gravity_forms.listener: AJAX forms: jQuery(document).on('gform_confirmation_loaded', (e, formId) => ...). Non-AJAX forms: tag the confirmation page or redirect.

contact_form_7.label: Contact Form 7
contact_form_7.listener: document.addEventListener('wpcf7mailsent', e => ...) - e.detail.contactFormId identifies the form. Do not use 'wpcf7submit', which also fires on validation errors.

wpforms.label: WPForms
wpforms.listener: AJAX forms: jQuery(document).on('wpformsAjaxSubmitSuccess', (e, response) => ...). Otherwise tag the confirmation page.

ninja_forms.label: Ninja Forms
ninja_forms.listener: jQuery(document).on('nfFormSubmitResponse', (e, r) => ...) - check r.response.errors is empty before pushing.

elementor.label: Elementor forms
elementor.listener: jQuery(document).on('submit_success', e => ...) - e.target is the form.

webflow.label: Webflow forms
webflow.listener: No success event. Watch for the .w-form-done block becoming visible (MutationObserver), or redirect to a tagged thank-you page.

squarespace.label: Squarespace forms
squarespace.listener: No public success event. Watch for the form's submission message appearing (MutationObserver), or use a post-submit redirect to a tagged page.
squarespace.verify: Selectors change between templates; confirm in GTM Preview.

mailchimp.label: Mailchimp embedded form
mailchimp.listener: Posts off-site. Use the hosted 'thank you' redirect to a tagged page, or the AJAX embed's success message.

salesforce_web_to_lead.label: Salesforce Web-to-Lead
salesforce_web_to_lead.listener: Posts to Salesforce, then redirects to retURL. Tag the retURL page and fire generate_lead there only when the referrer is the form page.

pardot.label: Account Engagement (Pardot) iframe form
pardot.listener: The parent page cannot see inside the iframe. Use a completion redirect to a tagged page, or add a postMessage to the form's thank-you code and listen for it.

typeform.label: Typeform embed
typeform.listener: Use the embed SDK's onSubmit callback (createWidget / data-tf-on-submit).

jotform.label: Jotform embed
jotform.listener: Redirect to a tagged thank-you page, or use Jotform's own Google Analytics integration.
jotform.verify: Jotform's iframe messages are not a documented API; confirm in GTM Preview.

calendly.label: Calendly booking
calendly.listener: window message event from https://calendly.com where event.data.event === 'calendly.event_scheduled'.

shopify_contact.label: Shopify contact form
shopify_contact.listener: The page reloads with ?contact_posted=true (or #contact_form). Fire on that page state, not on the submit click.
